neighbours.label: the separator ('.', '_', ':') right after a '1' in a protocol version or chapter:verse reference (HTTP/1.1, http_1_1, Hebrews 1:3)
fire: The server replied with HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found.
The proxy only speaks HTTP/1.0 to old clients.
As written in John 1:14, the Word became flesh.
See also Genesis 1:27 and Romans 1:20 for context.
We support http/1.1 and h2 for all upstream calls.
quiet: The server replied with HTTP/2 and a 404 status.
The proxy only speaks plain TCP to old clients.
As written in John chapter three, God so loved the world.
See also Genesis 3:15 and Romans 8:28 for context.
We support http/2 and h3 for all upstream calls.

notes: Drawn pole is the - pole. Top examples: 'HTTP/1[.]0', 'http_1[_]1', 'Hebrews 1[:]2', 'http/1[.]1'. Not probed; card only.
